paragraphs.text: Oasis was a complex web-published weaving of stories created by Wizards of the Coast in 1996, based on the Mirage expansion for Magic: The Gathering .

Stories told by Hakim Loreweaver are woven together to create an immersive "braided novel". At the end of each chapter, similar to the Choose-Your-Own-Adventure novels, readers might be given the option to shift over to a different character's perspective. The story is of the misdeeds of Bwire in Kenlo , motivated by an amber prison swallowed by a goat.

Readers who completed the story were asked to solve the mystery of who was in the amber prison. Submitting the correct answer and an email address would qualify the entry for prizes. At the competition's conclusion, ten people were announced as First Prize Winners, with one further Grand Prize winner.
